definitions.explanation: Food, in a blunt, casual register, mostly in men's speech.
Something or someone used for another's profit: 〜を{食|く}い{物|もの}にする, to exploit, to prey on.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧{食|く}い{物|もの}⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧?

examples.english: I'm starving, but there's no food.
There are lots of cheap, good places to eat around here.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高齢者|こうれいしゃ}→高齢者：15649_koureisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{食|く}い{物|もの}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{詐欺|さぎ}→詐欺：09789_sagi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Scams that prey on elderly people are increasing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{弱|よわ}い→弱い：00825_yowai⟧⟦{立場|たちば}→立場：03403_tachiba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{食|く}い{物|もの}にして⟦{金|かね}→金：02618_kane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{稼|かせ}いでいた→稼ぐ：02040_kasegu⟧。
examples.english: He made money by exploiting people in weak positions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{食|く}い{物|もの}にした⟦{経営者|けいえいしゃ}→経営者：16188_keieisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The executive who had milked the company was arrested.

notes:
USAGE:
- Sense 1 is casual and a little rough, like ⟦{食|く}う→食う：02657_kuu⟧ beside ⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧; in polite speech say ⟦{食|た}べ{物|もの}→食べ物：02890_tabemono⟧.
- Sense 2 appears almost only as 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{食|く}い{物|もの}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to exploit, to prey on), a set phrase used in news and serious talk, not slangy at all.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {食|く}い{物|もの}⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧: an eatery (casual)
- {食|く}い{物|もの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{恨|うら}み→恨み：00414_urami⟧: a grudge over food (said to run deep)
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{食|く}い{物|もの}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to exploit
